state: PARKED. Original unrestricted septic interval-box common-SPR-numerator decision remains OPEN. All results below are author-written candidates (WRITTEN or WRITTEN-checked-in-kernel), not parent adoption, formal proof, cross-vendor review (not performed) or novelty clearance.

headline_results.claim: All-degree constructive synthesis for every compact monic Hurwitz family whose even parts, or odd parts, lie on one positive ray (parity-scaled actual reference); terminating exact rational algorithm and explicit full-width neighborhoods; explicit all-seven-width septic box where the midpoint fails but the parity-scaled reference works.

Compactness is essential: a closed convex noncompact fixed-odd monic Hurwitz septic family has no common numerator, every bounded truncation has an explicit one, and no finite atom certificate exists (finite-subfamily no-go).

Direct obstructions to strict negative-coordinate atom certificates on any stable independent box: oriented alternating moment lemma; at least (n+3)/2 positive nodes in odd degree n (5 for septics); exactly three five-node phase patterns with two reversed root bands; for ANY support size one reversed even-root band and one disjoint reversed odd-root band with forced time-ordered corner orientations; five-node strict ratio barriers; diagonal-corner necessity.

Explicit solvable full-width stable boxes with strong necessary numerator structure: real seven-generator span excluded; universal odd and even coefficient halfspaces; exactly five forced coefficient-interval escapes (sharp, on an explicit 14D open set).

For every real R>=1000 an explicit constructively solvable stable full-width family forces b2>R^4/65, b4>R^4/100, b6>R^2/20 (b6>7R^2/80 for R>=5000) for EVERY common monic numerator; sharp orders Theta(R^4),Theta(R^4),Theta(R^2); coefficient-norm ratio Theta(R); unbounded monic solution rays; b6 projection exactly (m6,infinity); asymptotic b6-infimum bracket [8/91,20611/168500]; explicit numerator has four root scales.

Countermechanism (NOT an original counterexample): a compact convex all-Hurwitz septic polytope with separated alternating root bands has an exact five-atom strict negative certificate and no common numerator; its independent coefficient hull is unstable, so independent-box structure is essential to any positive theorem.

CONJECTURE (open): eligible boxes admit no exactly-five-positive-node strict certificate. Evidence only: seeded exact z3 sampling (7302 replayed samples, plus exploratory runs) found zero; the one-test F-separation proof route is exactly refuted.

exact_remaining_gap: No eligible full-width monic septic interval box with a strict negative-coordinate (or exact zero) actual-corner certificate has been found, and no universal positive synthesis theorem is proved. The five-node box conjecture is unproved; certificates with six or more positive nodes are constrained only by the all-support two-reversed-band/orientation theorems. All parametric families with forced numerator growth explicitly HAVE common numerators.
